decisions: CSharp current library proof executes all four source calls through declared native functions. Loaded metadata functions retain native identity without assuming a physical source-file slot.

SLG projectLibraries intentionally appends declaration-shaped nodes in module namespace prepared.package.ranges.len + interfaceIndex. This identity is also carried by call targetModule and parameter nodes, so it must not be remapped to an ordinary source module.

prepareGlobalValueNames currently allocates counters only for context.sources.len +1 slots, then indexes sourceModule+1 for every IR node. For the first imported interface module, scope becomes sources.len+1 and is out of bounds. Native runtime diagnostic names this exact function.

Allocate the declared namespace of physical source modules plus imported interface modules, with slot0 retained for sourceModule -1. Keep encoding source scope times2^32 plus per-scope ordinal and ordinary-source numbering unchanged. Extract the existing short pure numbering loop for focused unit admission; no arbitrary maximum, silent skip, native-ID remap or bounds bypass.

Before any further full compiler build, verify small ordinary/sentinel/multiple-library counter cases and a focused end-to-end source emitter consumer. The previous two full compiler builds are preserved; no automatic third retry is authorized by this record.

fullCompilerBuildBudget.reason: Resolve all observed imported-function emission consumers with small source-unit/emitter tests first
